_about: Public-domain August Neander (1789-1850, church historian at Berlin) in pre-1930 English translations: The Life of Jesus Christ (tr. M'Clintock and Blumenthal, 1870), Light in the Dark Places (1851) and his practical expositions of Philippians, James and 1 John (tr. Mrs H. C. Conant, 1853), clean from CCEL; and from the Internet Archive the General History of the Christian Religion and Church (tr. Joseph Torrey, 13th American ed., 5 vols) and The Planting and Training of the Christian Church (tr. J. E. Ryland, rev. E. G. Robinson, 1864). Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 15 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
